task.title: [M5] Walk compilation and independent multilayer regression verification
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M5
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M5-04
**Implementation status:** Accepted (done) after independent QA_PASS; all five mandatory criteria verified.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex (aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn); independent read-only forge_qa_reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§6/M5 acceptance, 7, 14
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Prove the M4 Walk composition compiles correctly before native acceptance.

**Scope:** Synthetic Walk image-to-compiler exercise, Rust canonical verification and Novice/Orc regressions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Use a synthetic legally distributable test monster with Walk action/views/frames/layers declared before art, exact PNG assignments and operator-approved composition.
- [x] Compile through production pipeline twice, compare output hashes and independently decode ordered layers/image mapping/timing/anchors with Rust.
- [x] Reconstruct real Orc Skeleton multilayer package without losing 12-layer death motion or transformed placement; bounded Novice replacement leaves unrelated slots/head unchanged.
- [x] Record requirements/assignment/composition snapshot, output hashes, structural/coverage and oracle results; missing private fixtures are NOT_RUN and do not erase their regression requirement.
- [x] One-view or smaller-than-runtime scope stays diagnostic/incomplete for full profile; structural/oracle PASS cannot claim native Walk proof.

## Verification

Reproduce synthetic bounded Walk end-to-end build/oracle comparison and private optional Novice/Orc regressions; capture commands/versions/statuses/hashes.

Actual commands, environment/tool versions, exits, hashes and NOT_RUN reasons are preserved in docs/verification/rsf-26. Synthetic operator review declarations are test inputs only; native execution is not claimed.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-25 (M5-03; task ID udjjt7jp22k3owbo05s8mnf8); RSF-5 (M0-05; task ID dpexmlk6wggb1xri9yefzjnq)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Native runtime claim belongs to M5-05, no automatic visual decisions.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

New tests: tests/test_walk_compilation.py and tests/private_fixture_hooks/test_walk_compilation_fixtures.py. Durable evidence: docs/verification/rsf-26/VERIFICATION.md, implementation.diff, implementation-manifest.json, source/requirements/assignment/composition snapshots and logs. No existing production source changes; all 90 baseline file hashes unchanged. No commit/push.

Coordinator exits all 0: 7 new public + 3 private focused tests; 14 canonical baseline; full public 452 PASS; private 40 PASS + 1 existing native-report skip; Rust parity 11 PASS; 10 schema checkers PASS; isolated installed distribution 443 PASS + 9 optional-tool skips (452 discovered), repeated wheels identical/private resources excluded. Python 3.14.4; 3.12/3.13 NOT_RUN unavailable. No UI changes/browser tests; native NOT_RUN.

Synthetic independent Rust original/output comparison: 3 targeted + 51 unaffected + 6 hidden, 0 mismatches. Two clean CLI builds identical ACT 43fffe83c1333772126a51e171a5d33d3b03ab1706f670f869099b1633b7617b, SPR 0d49b375c22b5cd738c8a448d564409e4bfdbf90a1a6593a62ec4db3756a6a81, canonical build file 3a7832608569ed9248bf42e1d3f0274ba0548937c76897e3450918aa219d1bd1. Novice: 1 targeted + 455 unaffected, other 103 slots/head unchanged. Orc: 1 targeted + 1775 unaffected, all 112 twelve-layer Death frames preserved. Metadata/raw RLE/palette/source immutability, cache/current authority, unbound production and failure publication regressions PASS. Synthetic operator decisions only, no real visual approval.

Implementation-manifest SHA-256: 9abb48737184ef3cbaefd468dd143f6eb8aafb36b8b7242903ca1fa8238ffc47.

M5-S PASS (bounded structural/preservation); M5-I PASS (supported Rust decoded fields/pixels); M5-N UNVERIFIED. M5 remains open; RSF-27 not started.

## Independent QA result

QA_PASS from separate read-only forge_qa_reviewer (/root/rsf24_qa). All five live criteria independently PASS, no mandatory finding. Independent focused/full public/private/Rust/schema and two-process reproduction PASS. Distribution evidence reviewed rather than independently rerun. No reviewer code edits, tracker writes or ownership changes. Durable QA report docs/verification/rsf-26/QA_REVIEW.md SHA256 34f9b53d66764a1100cfe3308dc615853efb7434ad2013aea57050f74b820d3f. Implementer Codex ownership retained. No technical correction required. M5-N remains UNVERIFIED; M5 open.
